person_note: The quotes repeatedly expose Vanessa’s participating first-person base narration, while the authorized Chapter One excerpt independently shows sustained third-person narration of Nellie. Multiple commercial whole-book structural sources describe the deliberate design: Part One alternates Vanessa’s first-person chapters with Nellie’s third-person chapters, even though the later twist reveals that they are the same woman at different times; subsequent narration is predominantly first person. Because both persons govern sustained sections rather than appearing only in speech or embedded material, the correct label is ALTERNATING. Confidence is medium because the whole-book structural sources are Tier C and the authorized excerpt covers only the opening.
